name: revyl
description: Run mobile changes on Revyl cloud devices and verify them with screenshots and semantic validation through the Revyl CLI.

interface.longDescription: Use the Revyl CLI to run mobile apps, inspect screenshots, validate behavior, and verify CI-uploaded pull request builds. Requires shell access and Revyl sign-in; does not require MCP or hooks.
defaultPrompt: Run this app on a Revyl device and verify my change.
Verify this pull request using its CI-uploaded Revyl build.
